lines.text: David cries out to God by day and by night, but God does not answer him.
David says he is a worm, and all who see him mock him and say the LORD should rescue him.
David says strong bulls of Moab encircle him and open their jaws against him like lions.
Evil men pierce his hands and feet, and they cast lots for his crown.
All the ends of the earth will turn to the LORD, and the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
